conflict_synopsis.core_view: Canada's relative growth and energy ToT are stronger than the post-Fed USDCAD squeeze prices, so fade USD versus CAD.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Post-FOMC USD squeeze fades while Canadian activity/ToT stay firm and CA-US 2Y cheapness mean-reverts.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: Canada loses its activity/consumer lead, oil demand destruction removes CAD ToT support, or G10 tightening extends the USD squeeze.

conflict_synopsis.core_view: Australian housing/labor slowdown plus broadening G10 tightening is not in AUDUSD, so the remaining risk-off expression is short AUD versus USD.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Further AU housing/labor deterioration and AU-US 2Y compression strip the AUD high-yielder bid.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: Australian labor/housing stabilize, AU-US front-end re-widens, and global policy reopens an easing path.

conflict_synopsis.core_view: The CA-US yield gap is historically extreme versus only a moderate USDCAD percentile, so own the view in USD spot versus CAD.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Fed tightening bias stays intact while BoC does not match and the Saudi workaround caps CAD's oil-tail hedge.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: CA-US 2Y compresses via a BoC hike or Fed easing, or a renewed oil-supply tail restores CAD terms-of-trade dominance.

conflict_synopsis.core_view: AUDCAD's 1y/5y extreme is USD-contaminated CAD weakness, not a justified AU-CA premium, so own Australia-versus-Canada outside USD.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Further AU housing/labor/sentiment deterioration versus Canadian energy pass-through and firmer activity.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: AU housing/labor rebound while CA activity and energy pass-through fade and CA-AU 2Y re-justifies AUDCAD richness.

conflict_synopsis.core_view: The verified CA-US 2Y carry of about 140bp is paid in long USDCAD and the energy/CAD narrative is not large enough to overwhelm that holding cost.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Delivered Fed hike plus near-2% Canadian core keeps the 140bp CA-US 2Y differential intact after the oil-supply tail was reduced.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: BoC hikes or the Fed eases enough to compress CA-US 2Y, or an energy-supply shock reopens a CAD ToT tail that overwhelms carry.

conflict_synopsis.core_view: Canadian headline inflation and BoC energy pass-through risk are underpriced versus a historically extreme CA-US yield discount after a fully priced Fed hike.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Next Canadian CPI or BoC communication converts the energy pass-through warning into a less-easy CA policy path.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: Canadian core stays near 2% and labor keeps cooling, so the cheap CA-US spread is revealed as warranted easier policy.

conflict_synopsis.core_view: RBA tightening is already biting housing, labor and sentiment while AU yields sit at a 99th-percentile extreme and AUDUSD still trades like a supported high-yielder.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Further AU labor/CPI/housing prints force an RBA easing reprice that AUDUSD has not discounted.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: AU labor re-tightens and housing stabilizes, or US activity/labor break first and collapse USD faster than AUD.

conflict_synopsis.core_view: AUDCAD is a 5y valuation extreme after the curve has already paid a large AU-over-CA 2Y premium, while AU housing is breaking and CAD still has energy ToT support.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Further AU housing/labor damage under 99th-percentile local yields while CAD activity and energy ToT stay the stronger comparable set.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: AU housing and activity re-accelerate while CAD ToT fades and the CA-AU 2Y discount reverses without AUDCAD leaving the 5y extreme.

conflict_synopsis.core_view: Do not fade the USDCAD grind: 1d/5d/1m spot, a still-widening CA-US front-end spread, and post-FOMC global tightening are aligned.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Fed tightening bias and Broader G10 tightening keep CA-US 2Y moving against CAD, extending the 5d/1m USDCAD trend.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: USDCAD 5d and 1m returns both turn negative while CA-US 2Y stops moving against CAD, or BoC policy closes the hawkish US-CA gap.

conflict_synopsis.core_view: AUDNZD's 5y extreme is an NZD-leg overshoot, not a justified AU-NZ re-rating, with AU housing bite and a clipped oil tail as reversal conditions.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: AU housing/labor transmission plus the Saudi workaround clipping the oil tail that had supported AUD versus NZD.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: AUDNZD makes a new high after NZ activity/labor deteriorate versus Australia, or AU housing stops showing the tightening channel biting.

conflict_synopsis.core_view: Fade the packet's most extended momentum-owned expression—long AUD versus dumped NZD—rather than chase a fully priced post-hike USD move.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Momentum/CTA de-lever of long AUDNZD after AU-US 2Y compressed and NZ's incremental news was a GDP beat plus FTA.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: NZ activity/labor keep deteriorating versus Australia, official NZ yields justify the cross, or a positioning print shows the opposite crowd.

conflict_synopsis.core_view: This week's broadening G10 tightening plus a reduced CAD oil-supply tail is the live path for CAD to keep cheapening versus USD while the extreme CA-US rate gap persists.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Fed/BoJ/hawkish-BoE decision week plus the 16 Sep Saudi workaround keep the CA-US 2Y gap from closing via BoC.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: Canadian core reaccelerates via named energy pass-through, or CAD yields close the CA-US 2Y gap the other way.

conflict_synopsis.core_view: AUDUSD spot cannot own the unresolved housing-versus-global-tightening fork; the expression is 1-month ATM vol, not direction.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Next RBA and Australian inflation prints versus still-elevated AU yields, with energy/global-tightening keeping a two-way policy fork.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: 1-month AUDUSD ATM implied vol is already rich to packet realized vol, or the AU housing/tightening fork resolves as a one-way AUD path.

conflict_synopsis.core_view: No G10 FX edge survives the research-method test: the policy catalysts are already in the tape, temperatures are near-neutral, and stretches lack a closing mechanism.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: None; the live policy cluster is already printed and adding spot now fails the why-now test.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: Official NZ yields, a post-decision OIS/vol surface, or a connected positioning feed would reopen a testable discrepancy.
conflict_synopsis.time_horizon: stand down after 16-18 Sep policy cluster

note: Recovery only. No conflict map, ranking, winner, or house view. Synopsis is a compression of each completed pitch, not a new opinion.
